mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Verona Community Park. Tonight, keep your eyes on the southern sky around 6:30 PM, as the space station will be visible, moving from the Belleville area toward Fitchburg and Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The city is currently busy with the Mark Drive reconstruction project. Work on phase two is underway, which includes new water and sewer lines, as well as fresh asphalt and new sidewalks between Rita Avenue and Nine Mound Road.

There is plenty to do this week. Today, you can join trivia nights at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, check out live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
Regarding the weekly police report, on October 25, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The restaurant is currently open and will remain so until 10 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
